name: Evidence Assembly Agent
fn: Pulls and scores documents from ERP, logistics and contracts into a case package
detail: Assembles the case evidence pack by retrieving and relevance-scoring documents from SAP SD/CS, field-service and contract systems via RAG. Cuts evidence gathering from hours per case to minutes.
sap: SAP FSCM-DM (UDM_DISPUTE_CREATE / CHANGE) · FI-AR credit memo (FB75) · SD / CS evidence
